migration_flags.description: Creating ir.model.access records with no group_id (global access) now emits a deprecation warning in v19. All access-granting ACL records must specify a group.
migration_flags.action: Audit all data files (CSV/XML) and custom modules for ir.model.access records without group_id. Assign a specific group to each.

migration_flags.description: check_access_rights() method on BaseModel is deprecated since v18.0. In v19 it delegates to check_access() or has_access().
migration_flags.action: Replace all calls to check_access_rights(operation, raise_exception=True) with check_access(operation) and check_access_rights(operation, raise_exception=False) with has_access(operation).

migration_flags.description: check_access_rule() method on BaseModel is deprecated since v18.0. In v19 it delegates to check_access().
migration_flags.action: Replace all calls to check_access_rule(operation) with check_access(operation).

migration_flags.description: _filter_access_rules() and _filter_access_rules_python() are deprecated since v18.0. Use _filtered_access() instead.
v19 introduces a res_groups_privilege table (privilege categories for groups). group_names_with_access() now left-joins this table for group name prefixes.
migration_flags.action: No immediate migration required but be aware group name display format may change for groups with privilege categories.

key_findings.acl_check_algorithm: check() at ir_model.py:2163 — superuser bypass first (env.su), then delegates to _get_allowed_models() cached per uid+mode; OR logic across all matching ACL records via GROUP BY in SQL
key_findings.superuser_bypass: env.su=True bypasses ACL in IrModelAccess.check() (line 2164) and bypasses record rules in IrRule._get_rules() (line 120); complete ORM security bypass
key_findings.global_vs_group_acl: _get_allowed_models SQL: a.group_id IS NULL OR a.group_id IN user_groups; _get_access_groups: any null group_id returns universe expression
key_findings.two_stage_check: _check_access in orm/models.py:4141 — (1) model-level ACL via IrModelAccess.check(), (2) record-level via IrRule._compute_domain(); ACL must pass before rules are evaluated
key_findings.caching: _get_allowed_models cached per uid+mode; _get_access_groups cached per model+mode in stable registry cache; both cleared on any ACL CRUD via call_cache_clearing_methods()
key_findings.deprecated_methods: check_access_rights(), check_access_rule(), _filter_access_rules() all deprecated since v18.0; new unified API is check_access() / has_access() / _filtered_access()
key_findings.allow_sudo_commands: _allow_sudo_commands=False on IrModelAccess (line 2084) blocks sudo-elevated writes to the ACL table itself
key_findings.rule_domain_logic: ir.rule: global rules AND-ed, group rules OR-ed within group set then AND-ed with globals; superuser gets empty ruleset

fields.name: Char, required, indexed — ACL record label
fields.group_id: Many2one res.groups, optional, indexed, ondelete=restrict — null means global
